body:
Greg, 2026-11-07 07:55Z (Asistant #40, relayed by Kimi::Consultant, TermAl mailbox 852a55c9 #105), verbatim: „Przez to Kimi. To jest problem z takimi testami. Testy negatywne dla timeout to duzy problem.”
Context: the real 9 s / 31 s sleeping test added for the 30 s source_id limit change was unnecessary.
RULE:
- Don't multiply suite time with real sleeps or real timeouts. Negative timeout tests that wait for real are a big problem.
- When timing behaviour genuinely needs coverage, use deterministically controlled time or IO (fake clock, scripted process seam, mock timers) and check the observable result.
- A simple limit or value change needs no timing test at all („Zmien wartosc i tyle”).
- No new gates and no tautological tests.
Recorded by Termal::Fable2.
